summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of QRU Factory iteration 2 (QRU teaching methodology, Translation Engine, Verification Center review workflow, AI Director Departments, Understanding Colleges, expanded Executive Command Center, Music player, rebrand). Backend: 15/15 new iteration-2 pytest cases pass PLUS 29/30 regression cases from iteration-1 (see note below). Frontend: 40/40 UI assertions pass — all iteration-2 flows work end to end including real GPT-5.5 calls for Translation Engine and Manufacture Understanding, review approve/reject/request-revision, department dialog, colleges + workspace, all 8 music modes, global search Colleges group, navy sidebar + gold active states + QRU shield.

minor.issue: Legacy endpoint from iteration 1 has been removed (returns 404). Iteration-2 replaces it with /manufacture-understanding (per-KR) and /api/translation-engine (standalone). The old regression test still calls /translate and now fails. Not a real bug — iteration-1's backend_test.py should be updated to call the new endpoints. All other 29 regression tests still pass.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Purely accessibility — non-blocking. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to each DialogContent.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestKnowledgeRecords::test_translate_kr — replace POST /knowledge-records/{id}/translate with POST /knowledge-records/{id}/manufacture-understanding (the iteration-2 replacement). This is a test-suite update, not a product change.
MINOR A11y: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to VerificationCenter ReviewDialog and DigitalWorkforce Department dialog to remove the Radix console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.llm_generate now wraps LLM errors in HTTPException(503) — good, resolves the 500-on-transient-failure issue flagged in iteration 1.

routers/workforce.py department(): the `mo_query = {'assigned_employees': e['id']} if False else {}` is dead code — the `if False` will always fall through to {}. Either implement per-director filtering or remove the dead branch.

routers/colleges.py list_colleges(): live counts of records/products for each college are computed by two count_documents() per college inside a loop — N+1 pattern. Fine for ~14 colleges but replace with a single $group aggregation before scaling.
routers/analytics.py knowledge_growth remains synthetic — flagged in iteration 1, still present. Acceptable for MVP but should be replaced with real time-series aggregation before production.

routers/knowledge.py review_record: when decision='approve' the code auto-promotes AI-drafted sections to Verified — semantically correct, but there's no way to reject a specific section; consider per-section approval later.
server.py: CORS middleware still added AFTER include_router (works but non-conventional). Also allow_origins default '*' + allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid; move to explicit origins list.
routers/misc.py users_router.create_user still allows creating additional Administrators from an admin session — flagged in iteration 1, still present.

success_rate.backend: iteration-2 suite 100% (15/15); regression 96.7% (29/30, only failure is a legacy endpoint that was intentionally replaced)
